hebrewText: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְ/אָ֫סָ֥ף אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים נִצָּ֥ב בַּ/עֲדַת אֵ֑ל בְּ/קֶ֖רֶב אֱלֹהִ֣ים יִשְׁפֹּֽט

tokens.bdb: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes

tokens.bdb: to station, in various applications (literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: appointed, deputy, erect, establish, [idiom] Huzzah (by mistake for a proper name), lay, officer, pillar, present, rear up, set (over, up), settle, sharpen, establish, (make to) stand(-ing, still, up, upright), best state.

tokens.bdb: a stated assemblage (specifically, a concourse, or generally, a family or crowd)
tokens.kjv: assembly, company, congregation, multitude, people, swarm. Compare H5713 (עֵדָה).

tokens.bdb: strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity)
tokens.kjv: God (god), [idiom] goodly, [idiom] great, idol, might(-y one), power, strong. Compare names in '-el.'

tokens.bdb: properly, the nearest part, i.e. the center, whether literal, figurative or adverbial (especially with preposition)
